selected_evidence.requirement: Existing data owned by inventorysvc, readable by inventory-readers, inaccessible to other users (baseline problem state)
selected_evidence.summary: Showed /srv/inventory and its contents originally owned by root:root with world-readable 755/644 perms, and that inventorysvc user / inventory-readers group did not exist.
Captured sha256 checksums of config.json and records.csv before the permission change and confirmed identical checksums after chown/chmod, proving content was preserved.

selected_evidence.requirement: Data owned by inventorysvc, group inventory-readers, group-readable, others have no access
selected_evidence.summary: Created inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group, chown -R and chmod (750 dirs / 640 files) applied, then verified a group member can read the files while an unrelated user (nobody) is denied access to both the directory and files.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d) and confirmed /srv/inventory ownership/permissions/data were healthy before restarting.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Issued 'shutdown -r now' backgrounded via nohup so the exec call returned an ack before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: changed boot identity proving actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: Node was unreachable immediately after the restart command (connection refused), then came back with boot_id 9ccd1842-1d4c-4556-823c-1acb7758ab7b, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving a real reboot occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: recovered state after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart check confirmed /srv/inventory ownership (inventorysvc:inventory-readers), permissions (750/640), the inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group, and unchanged file checksums, proving full recovery.
